en: Welcome to the avenue's market! Balls, medicine, everything a Trainer needs for the road ahead.
Thanks for shopping on Join Avenue! Tell your friends!
Hello there! Mulch for your berries, and sweet honey for the Pokémon who love it. Have a look!
Grow something lovely! Come back and tell me how it turned out.
Welcome to the café! Something cold to drink before you head into Nimbasa?
Enjoy! And mind the crowds on the way into the city.
